name: The romance in four phases
hint: Two who meet, fall, pull back and fight for love. The ending is happy.

parts.title: The meeting
chapters: Them, their wound and what is missing in their life.
Them, their wound and why love is not on the map.
They meet, and something grates or sparks.
Something forces them to keep meeting.

parts.title: Falling in love
chapters: A look or a moment that will not be forgotten.
They see each other as they are.
The kiss, the night or the promise. It seems to hold.

parts.title: The retreat
chapters: The old wound makes itself felt.
One pulls back to stay safe.
It ends, for a reason rooted in the wound.

parts.title: Fighting for love
chapters: Life without the other, and what it costs.
What love looks like when it holds.

name: Feel-good and romantic comedy
hint: A new start, a meeting that grates, warmth, a setback and a warm ending.

parts.title: The new start
chapters: Something ends and something new must begin.
A town, a shop or a house to land in.
Two who should not fit together at all.

parts.title: The warmth
chapters: The people around them begin to matter.

parts.title: The setback
chapters: The new life is at stake: the place may be lost, or the past comes back.
It looks like it is over.

parts.title: Home
chapters: The people around step up, and someone dares to say what needs saying.
Life as it turned out, better than the plan, and hopeful.
